description: This file defines the IVSClient class for AWS SDK PHP, which interacts with the Amazon Interactive Video Service API. It primarily contains method annotations for API operations, indicating the methods available to communicate with the service.

classes.name: Aws\IVS\IVSClient
classes.description: The client class for interacting with Amazon Interactive Video Service (IVS). It extends the base AwsClient and provides methods mapped to IVS API operations, such as createChannel, deleteStreamKey, getStream, etc.

methods.name: batchGetChannel
methods.description: Retrieves details for multiple channels in a single request.

methods.name: createChannel
methods.description: Creates a new channel for streaming.

methods.name: getStream
methods.description: Gets information about a specific stream.
